claim: dispatchprice has exactly one row per region and interval (no intervention rows), so INTERVENTION=0 drops nothing
sql: SELECT count(*)=count(DISTINCT (SETTLEMENTDATE,REGIONID)) AND max(INTERVENTION)=0 FROM dispatchprice

claim: every region has the same 288 intervals on the day
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT SETTLEMENTDATE)=288 AND count(*)=288*5 FROM dispatchprice

claim: no FCAS price is negative (they are floored at zero)

sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE RAISE6SECRRP IS NULL OR RAISE60SECRRP IS NULL OR RAISE5MINRRP IS NULL OR RAISEREGRRP IS NULL OR LOWER6SECRRP IS NULL OR LOWER60SECRRP IS NULL OR LOWER5MINRRP IS NULL OR LOWERREGRRP IS NULL)=0 FROM dispatchprice
